Strategy: Apply the gentle fifteen sweet band only when at least three bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This lowers the gate so steering engages earlier, but it may steer in sparse states where Best Fit already chooses well.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if len(bins) >= 3 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
